text:
Root cause: `Style.update_link()` copied the original style’s cached hash even after changing the link. This made linked and unlinked styles compare equal, causing link ranges to render incorrectly and preventing HTML export from recognizing the hyperlink.

Fixed `Style.update_link()` to invalidate the cached hash when creating the updated style. All targeted tests now pass.

         return style

final_text:
Root cause: `Style.update_link()` copied the original style’s cached hash even after changing the link. This made linked and unlinked styles compare equal, causing link ranges to render incorrectly and preventing HTML export from recognizing the hyperlink.

Fixed `Style.update_link()` to invalidate the cached hash when creating the updated style. All targeted tests now pass.
